PDF Real-Time Volumetric Rendering of Fire in a Production System ...
Many techniques of rendering fire in non real-time exist and are constantly employed by the movie industry. Many of the systems developed for rendering fire in offline mode directly influenced and inspired real-time fire rendering, including this thesis.
